_note: Paid math problems / bounties. Checked by web search 2026-11-07. prize_watch.py re-checks every link weekly. 'fit' = how realistic for us (computation-friendly = high; needs a real proof = low).

prizes.name: Squares in Squares (Kaggle)
prizes.task: Pack n unit squares (n = 1..1000) into the smallest square; score = sum of (L/sqrt(n) - 1). Pure optimisation, no proof needed.
prizes.eligibility: Kaggle account, adult, not in a sanctioned region; teams up to 5

prizes.name: Conjectures.io bounties
prizes.amount: per problem (e.g. about $4,700 listed); 272 live bounties
prizes.task: Proof of a stated conjecture, checked by the Lean proof assistant. Why: needs a real machine-checked proof; crypto payout.
prizes.eligibility: anyone; AI help allowed if the proof is original

prizes.name: Erdős problems prizes
prizes.amount: about $59,700 in total across listed problems
prizes.task: Solve a listed Erdős problem (proof or counterexample). Why: some ask for a counterexample, which computation can find.

prizes.name: Collatz conjecture prize
prizes.task: Proof or disproof, accepted by a qualifying journal

prizes.name: Beal Prize
prizes.task: Proof or counterexample of the Beal conjecture

prizes.name: Millennium Prize Problems
prizes.task: Published proof accepted for 2 years. Why: our work is evidence, not proof.
